messages:
emma: Quick flag from Monarch onboarding healthcheck — p95 climbed ~140ms -> ~270ms during weekday mornings, CS said renewal sentiment drops if we don’t show a plan :grimacing:
raj: Do we have traces? compute vs queue?
luca: Mostly queueing on their 30B fp16 endpoint. High KV cache churn for long sessions. No quant in prod.
emma: My proposal: a "performance pact" pilot — run a 30B-int8 variant for priority traffic on a dedicated pool + a hosted 6B compact fallback for bursty/non-critical routes. Small canary, validate quality.
taylor: Love the "pact" naming—makes it easier for CS to position to customer. Canary plan: 3% traffic -> monarch-30b-int8 (dedicated-usw), 5% -> monarch-6b-compact (hosted-fallback). 2-week observation window.
raj: Routing policy suggestion: route_by_priority tag -> dedicated pool in us-west; if queue_depth > 8 OR per-request latency > 1.8s -> failover to hosted-6b. Per-route timeout 2.2s, circuit-breaker: 1 retry then fallback.
luca: ML notes: int8 build will need attention-kernel tuning for seq_len ~1600 and a KV-prefetch tweak. We'll run regen-quality eval and token-cost calc on Monarch prompt corpus.
emma: CS wants the numbers for the renewal binder: token-cost delta, regen-fidelity (BLEU/F1/regression rate), and latency delta.
luca: Draft canary config (will refine):
```json
{
  "canary": { "percent": 3 },
  "models": [
    { "name": "monarch-30b-int8", "route": "dedicated-usw" },
    { "name": "monarch-6b-compact", "route": "hosted-fallback" }
  ]
}
```
taylor: Ops checklist for rollout: enable KV-prefetch and pre-warm canary nodes, set autoscale min=2 for canary pool, add circuit-breaker rules, and expose per-route metrics in the console (p50/p95/p99, queue depth, token-cost).
raj: Add alerts: p95 > 300ms, regen-f1 drop > 2pt, or token-cost delta > expected +20%. Also log prompt_id + eval_id for any flagged regressions to auto-link in the console dashboard.
luca: Ballpark cost impact: int8 ~33% token cost reduction vs fp16; 6B compact ~7020-72% on fallback traffic. Latency: int8 compute may add ~10-20ms on short sequences but should reduce queue-induced tail overall.
emma: Perfect. I'll draft the CS playbook + rollback criteria and propose the pact to Monarch in next week's renewal prep.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-9801 for Monarch performance pact canary and link ML-EVAL-900.
luca: I'll post the eval suite and a short A/B script by EOD. Includes regen samples, acceptance thresholds, and automated scoring.
taylor: Add a clear rollback trigger: regen-f1 drop > 3pt OR percentage of responses flagged by Monarch > 1% sustained over 1 hour.
emma: Thanks all 1 tagging @luca @raj @taylor. Aim to schedule a 30m handoff with Monarch Fri 11am PT to walk the pact and get explicit buy-in. This gives them a measurable path to lower unit cost and stabilize p95 before renewal. :rocket:
